ad.title: Model Relationship Manager
ad.summary: Halevora manages some of the biggest names in online creator content, and every one of them signed because a real person earned their trust first. That person is you. You are the friendly, steady contact who talks to creators considering us, answers the questions they will not ask a stranger, and keeps the creators already on our roster feeling heard and looked after. This is a relationship role, not a chat sales role: your job is people, not fans.

paragraphs: Creators thinking about joining an agency are careful, and they should be. Most of the industry approaches them with copy-paste pitches. You do the opposite: you reach out like a person, listen to what they actually want from their career, explain honestly how we work, and stay in touch until they are ready to decide. When they sign, that is your win.

The other half of the job is keeping our current creators happy. You check in, catch problems while they are small, pass feedback to the team, and make sure nobody on the roster ever feels like a number. Creators who feel looked after stay, and they refer their friends.

disclosure.label: The work, in plain terms
paragraphs: We will not waste your time or ours, so here is exactly what this is. Halevora is a management agency for creators on adult content subscription platforms. Everyone we work with is 18 or over, and the creators you talk to earn their living making 18+ content.

Your role is with the creators themselves, not their audience. You never chat with fans, you are never on camera, and you are never asked to produce, appear in, or share any content of your own. You need to be comfortable talking about the business side of adult content plainly and without judgment, because the creators you support deserve someone who treats their work as work.
If that is something you can stand behind, you are exactly who we want. If it is not for you, that is completely fair, and it is kinder to stop here than to apply.

idealCandidate: People open up to you. Friends come to you for advice, and strangers tell you their life story in a queue.
You write and speak warm, natural English and you sound like yourself in both.
You follow up without being pushy. You keep promises, remember details, and show up when you said you would.
You can talk about the adult creator business plainly, without judgment and without awkwardness.
You are organised enough to run many relationships at once without letting any of them go cold.
You are discreet. Creators trust you with their real names, their numbers, and their plans.
Experience in sales, account management, community, hospitality, or creator management is a plus, not a rule.

requirements.title: Warmth that converts
requirements.body: Creators sign with the agency whose people they trust. You build that trust one honest conversation at a time, over weeks if that is what it takes, and you never resort to pressure or hype.

requirements.title: Comfort with the industry
requirements.body: You talk to adult content creators about their careers every day. You need to be genuinely at ease with what they do, discuss it as a business, and represent us without embarrassment.

requirements.title: Consistency
requirements.body: You keep a clean pipeline, log every conversation, and follow up on time, every time. A creator who hears from you when you promised is a creator who answers the next message.

requirements.title: Discretion
requirements.body: Creators share their legal names and private lives with you. Everything you learn stays inside the team. Screenshots, sharing, or gossip end the job on the spot.

whatYoullDo: Be the first human contact for creators considering Halevora, from first message to signed agreement.
Run warm, honest conversations by chat, voice note, and video call, in your own voice and on the creator's schedule.
Check in regularly with creators on our roster, catch concerns early, and route feedback to the right team.
Work with our talent team on outreach lists, and turn cold leads into real conversations.
Keep your pipeline and conversation notes clean so nothing and nobody slips through.
Protect every creator's identity and personal details as strictly confidential.
shouldntApply: You are uncomfortable around the adult creator industry. It is the context of every conversation you will have.
You think relationship building means pressure tactics. One burned creator costs us ten referrals.
You go quiet for days at a time. Consistency is the job.
You cannot keep a secret. Discretion here is absolute.
